example.en: Both companies agreed to submit to a decision made by the committee.
example.zh: 兩家公司同意接受委員會做出的決定。

example.en: Staff must submit to authority when safety rules are not clear.
example.zh: 當安全規定不明確時，員工必須聽從上級的指示。

example.en: All visitors must submit to the rules of the building.
example.zh: 所有訪客都必須遵守大樓的規定。
